International law firm in Brussels.

• Recruitment and onboarding of new employees
• Performance management and employee development
• Training coordination
• Employee relations and engagement initiatives
• HR support and guidance to employees and managers
Hard HR

• Payroll coordination and administration
• Management of employee contracts and HR documentation
• Time and attendance follow-up
• Benefits administration
• Ensuring compliance with labour law and internal HR policies

• Minimum 3 years of experience in payroll administration or in a HR Generalist role.
• Good knowledge of Belgian labour and social legislation.
• Excellent command of English, both written and spoken and Good working knowledge of French and Dutch.
• Strong proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel.
• Interest in new HR systems and technologies.
• Strong service-oriented mindset with a genuine desire to support employees throughout their career journey.
• Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail.
• Flexible, with the ability to manage changing priorities effectively.
• Solution-oriented, proactive, and accountable.
• Ability to build trusted relationships with a wide range of stakeholders.
• Positive, approachable, and collaborative personality.

The successful candidate will maintain positive relationships with clients, legal professionals, and internal stakeholders while ensuring the highest level of confidentiality at all times.

 

Client Details

Our client is a leading international law firm with a strong presence in Brussels. They are currently seeking an experienced Management Assistant to provide high-level administrative and organisational support to a team of lawyers within a fast-paced and demanding environment.

 

Description

As a Management Assistant, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day operation of the legal team by providing comprehensive administrative support.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing complex calendars and coordinating meetings.
• Organising domestic and international travel arrangements.
• Assisting with client onboarding and matter opening processes.
• Supporting billing and expense management activities.
• Drafting, proofreading, formatting and finalising legal documents and correspondence.
• Managing document filing and record-keeping systems.
• Handling incoming calls, emails, and correspondence professionally.
• Coordinating meeting rooms and related services, including catering and IT support.
• Liaising with internal departments and external stakeholders.
• Ensuring a high level of confidentiality and professionalism at all times.
• Providing general administrative support and assisting with ad hoc projects.
 

• Strong previous experience as a Management Assistant, ideally within an international law firm or professional services environment.
• Excellent organisational and multitasking skills.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities.
• Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint).
• Experience with document management systems is an advantage.
• Fluent English, together with French and/or Dutch.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Professional, proactive and service-oriented mindset.
• Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
• Flexible and adaptable approach in a fast-paced environment.

We are looking for an experienced Executive Assistant to provide high-level support to the Director General. This is a key position requiring exceptional organisational skills, professionalism, discretion, and the ability to operate confidently in a fast-paced international environment.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established European association based in Brussels, representing and supporting members across Europe. Operating in an international and multicultural environment, the organisation plays a key role in fostering collaboration, advocacy, and knowledge sharing within its sector.

Description

• Act as the trusted right hand and strategic support to the Director General
• Manage a complex agenda, shifting priorities, and high-level executive commitments
• Coordinate international travel, itineraries, and meeting preparations
• Monitor and manage the Director General's inbox, correspondence, and follow-ups
• Prepare presentations, briefing documents, reports, and executive materials
• Ensure action points are tracked and deadlines are met across multiple projects
• Organise and coordinate Board Meetings, General Assemblies, and leadership meetings
• Take meeting minutes and follow up on agreed actions
• Build strong relationships with members, partners, and key stakeholders across Europe
• Liaise with internal teams to ensure smooth communication and coordination
• Handle sensitive and confidential information with the highest level of discretion
• Maintain accurate records, databases, and executive documentation
• Review expenses, approvals, and administrative processes
• Act as a key point of contact on behalf of the Director General when required
• Support the smooth functioning of the executive office and provide back-up within the administrative team
• Anticipate needs, solve problems proactively, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks
 

• 15 to 20 years of experience in a similar Executive Assistant role
• Previous experience supporting C-level or Executive-level leadership
• Experience within an international organisation, association, federation, or EU environment is highly desirable
• Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in English
• Excellent command of Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook)
• Strong organisational and prioritisation skills
• Proactive, resourceful, and solution-oriented mindset
• Highly professional, trustworthy, and discreet
• Eager to learn and continuously improve

Are you an organised and service-oriented professional who enjoys being at the heart of office life? In this part-time role, you will support the daily operations of a busy international office, ensuring employees and visitors enjoy a seamless and welcoming workplace experience.

• You have at least 1 year of experience in administration, office coordination, reception or workplace support.

• You have a strong service mindset and enjoy supporting both colleagues and visitors.

• You are reliable, discreet and able to work independently.
• You are available to work on-site in Brussels on a part-time basis, Monday to Friday from 9AM to 1PM.

Are you a hands-on and service-minded professional who enjoys creating a welcoming and well-organised workplace? In this varied role, you will ensure the smooth daily operation of a modern international office while acting as a key contact for employees, visitors and external service providers.

Our client is a well-established international organisation based in Brussels, bringing together professionals and stakeholders from across Europe. Thanks to its close relationship with its client, employees benefit from the scale, complexity, and career opportunities of a large multinational organization while enjoying the agility, accessibility, and human-sized culture of a smaller consultancy structure.

• SQL

jobs.occupation: Group Internal Auditor - Brussels - Financial Services
jobs.description:
Our client is an established international financial services group headquartered in Brussels. Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the company makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Are you ready for a new challenge where your expertise can truly make a difference?

If you have a Scientific degree and experience in Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or related field, this is your opportunity to be part of something bigger than yourself. As an Operations Expert, you'll play a key role in manufacturing advanced cell therapies that are transforming cancer treatment and giving patients new hope.

Every day, your work will directly contribute to delivering life-changing therapies to patients facing serious diseases. Join a passionate team united by a shared purpose: creating innovative treatments and improving lives around the world.

Your key responsibilities:

• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste.

Who we are looking for:

• You have obtained at least a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.
• Cell experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
